traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS.story.md are implemented and verified:
- Optional Warning (REQ-OPTIONAL-WARNING): Rule `prefer-implements-annotation` is a suggestion rule, disabled by default, and emits `preferImplements` diagnostics when both `@story` and `@req` (and no `@supports`) are present. Confirmed by implementation in src/rules/prefer-implements-annotation.ts and tests in tests/rules/prefer-implements-annotation.test.ts. - Auto-fix Support & Single Story Conversion (REQ-AUTO-FIX, REQ-SINGLE-STORY-FIX): Conservative auto-fix implementation rewrites eligible single-story `@story` + multiple `@req` lines into a single `@supports` line while preserving prefix and comment structure. Verified by tests that assert exact `output` strings. - Multi-story Detection (REQ-MULTI-STORY-DETECT): Implementation detects multiple distinct `@story` paths and mixed `@story`/`@req`/`@supports` and emits appropriate `multiStoryDetected` and `cannotAutoFix` messages, confirmed by dedicated tests. - Preserve Order & Format (REQ-PRESERVE-FORMAT): Auto-fix replaces only the original `@story` line with a `@supports` line using the same indentation/prefix and removes only the legacy annotation lines, preserving the rest of the JSDoc structure. Behavior is validated indirectly by exact string output tests and by the use of the original line’s prefix in the fixer. - Configurable Enforcement (REQ-CONFIG-SEVERITY): Rule is not enabled in recommended/strict presets, and separate tests confirm it can be configured to 'warn' or 'error' via flat config. This matches the story’s off/warn/error configuration requirement. - Both Formats Valid & Backward Compatibility (REQ-BACKWARD-COMP-VALIDATION): Valid tests show comments with only `@story`, only `@req`, only `@supports`, and mixed but non-migratable patterns are all treated as valid when this rule is not triggered. Core validation rules continue to function independently, and the rule is disabled by default in configs. - Quality Standards / Valid Output (REQ-VALID-OUTPUT): Auto-fixed `@supports` annotations are constrained to simple patterns that are known to pass `valid-annotation-format` and `valid-req-reference` rules. These validation suites pass in the same test run, demonstrating that auto-fix output is accepted by all existing validators. - Documentation: A dedicated rule doc at docs/rules/prefer-implements-annotation.md provides migration guidance, examples, and configuration instructions that align with the story’s implementation notes.
Given the presence of a complete rule implementation, targeted tests tied to this story and its REQ IDs, a passing full test suite, proper plugin wiring, and matching documentation, this story is fully implemented.
